results.name: Flamethrower
results.description:
1. The Literal Device (Military & Industrial)
At its core, a flamethrower is a mechanical device designed to project a long, controllable stream of fire.
How it Works: Most models use a pressurized tank of flammable liquid (like gasoline or diesel thickened with napalm) and a separate tank of pressurized gas (like nitrogen) to propel the fuel through a nozzle. An igniter at the tip lights the fuel as it exits.
Military History: They were famously used in WWI and WWII to "clear" bunkers and trenches. Most modern militaries have moved away from them in favor of thermobaric weapons.
Industrial Use: Controlled "drip torches" are used by foresters and farmers for prescribed burns to prevent wildfires or clear land.

results.name: ERYX TTT-Triton Dropship [Concept]

TTT-Triton (Tango Toroid Transporter)
Model: C-88 "Triton" Multi-Role Dropship
Designation: TAM Toroid Link Transporter (T-L-T)
Operators: Stellar Concorde Research Division / TAM Special Operations

The TTT-Triton is the iconic product of Stellar Concorde engineering, serving in both civil research and high-stakes TAM combat support. The Triton is designed to transport modular cargo rings or pre-fabricated Ridge Outpost units. Once in position, the Causal Generator can be detached and remotely piloted, allowing for placement of research labs or combat bunkers even in extreme weather or high-gravity environments. TAM Tactical Extraction: During combat extractions, the Triton’s ring generates a localized Inertial Dampening Field.

results.name: MECH-CRAB ENFORCER
results.description:
Character Bio: Mech-Crab Enforcer
Name: Mech-Crab Enforcer
Alias: Iron Claw, The Abyssal Sentinel
Type: Cybernetic Enforcer Unit
Origin: Deep-Sea Military Bio-Engineering Program
Appearance
A towering hybrid of crustacean and machine, the Mech-Crab Enforcer’s armored shell is forged from deep-sea alloys resistant to extreme pressure and plasma weaponry. Its massive pincers are capable of crushing reinforced steel, while glowing eyes and antennae serve as advanced scanning sensors. The fusion of biological tissue and mechanical plating gives it both raw power and tactical intelligence.
Abilities & Powers
Titanium Pincers – Capable of pulverizing tanks, ships, and reinforced bunkers.
EMP Discharge – Emits a short-range electromagnetic pulse to disable enemy electronics.
Hydro-Boost Thrusters – Grants high mobility in both water and land-based combat.
Thermal Vision & Sonar – Detects cloaked or hidden enemies in any environment.
